mentions.name: CodeHydra
mentions.description: This IDE lets developers work with multiple AI agents in isolated workspaces. Each task is isolated not only with a git worktree but also with all other task-related context such as previews and reviews, and agents can interact with that context via notifications.
mentions.source_excerpt:
a IDE to work with multiple AI agents in isolated workspaces.
https://codehydra.dev / https://github.com/stefanhoelzl/codehydra

It is not only isolating with a git worktree but also all other context related to this task (previews, reviews) and allows the agent to interact with this context via notifications and so on.
